content: {"reasoning":"CPT 93229 requires prior authorization that is missing, and silverbridge offers neither a retroactive authorization window nor peer-to-peer review, so no self-service path exists to cure the auth defect. Submitting (with or without records) would be a knowing submission against the payer's published prior-auth requirement and would draw an auth denial; appeal and P2P are unavailable without a denial and, for P2P, are not offered at all. Billing the patient is barred since the missing auth is provider liability, and writing off $600.73 at day 0 with 158 days of filing time left is premature. The only proper progression is to hand this to the diligent specialist to pursue an authorization exception/administrative remedy with the plan.","action":"escalate"}
